# Input Select

```tsx
import { InputSelect, InputSelectContent, InputSelectGroup, InputSelectGroupLabel, InputSelectItem, InputSelectSeparator } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

Picks a value from a list of options. Mirrors the Figma Input Select component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error. Active is the open list, which is the Figma Dropdown. Pass `items` so the field can show the label of the selected value.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<InputSelect
  {...args}
  icon={getLeadingIcon({ showIcon, icon })}
  onValueChange={(value) => {
    updateArgs({ value })
    onValueChange?.(value)
  }}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input Select component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error. It shares the label, field, Focus ring and messages with Input Text; Active is the open list, shown with the Focus ring and Chevron Up. The list itself is the Figma Dropdown with .Dropdown Item Single rows.
The trigger fills the field so the whole field opens the list. Button Clear can't live inside the trigger button, so it sits on top of a spacer that keeps the value clear of it.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`InputSelectProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `className?` | `string` | Classes for the root, around the label, field and messages. |
| `placeholder?` | `React.ReactNode` | Text shown while nothing is selected. |
| `icon?` | `IconSvgElement` | Leading 20px icon. |
| `prefix?` | `React.ReactNode` | Text before the value, like "R$" or "+55". |
| `children?` | `React.ReactNode` | The options: `InputSelectItem`, `InputSelectGroup`... |
| `contentProps?` | `InputSelectContentProps` | Props for the list popup. |
| `"aria-label"?` | `string` | Accessible name of the field, when it has no `label`. |

## Types

`InputSelectContentProps`, `InputSelectProps`

## Rules

- Import `InputSelect` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
